dedupe_keys.name: psp ufu graphical power system simulator

description: PSP-UFU is the Federal University of Uberlandia team's graphical software for constructing electrical transmission-network and controller models. It supports power flow, balanced and unbalanced short circuits, harmonic analysis, frequency scans and transient or dynamic stability studies. Users draw network elements and controller block diagrams and assign parameters; outputs include linked text, tables and graphs. Geographic coverage and network detail are user-configured. Public C++ source and build instructions are free under GPL-2.0. A limitation is that supported machine models and numerical methods must fit the intended study, while local builds require the documented compiler, CMake and graphical-library dependencies. A graphical network representation does not replace verified equipment parameters. PSP-UFU can support transmission and protection simulations, complementary to PyPSA (model-pypsa) for planning studies. Its multilingual interface serves research, teaching and industrial applications, and the README cites two 2019 software papers. No executable or network model was downloaded.
